standard.summary: 使用 Unsloth 风格的梯度卸载技术，在 backward 过程中将非必要的中间激活卸载到 CPU，进一步降低 VRAM 峰值。
standard.effect: 可以进一步节省 VRAM，使更大分辨率或更多 batch 的训练成为可能，代价是训练速度略有下降。
standard.whenToUse: 开启 gradient_checkpointing 和 block_prefetch 仍然 OOM 时的最后手段。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足时不建议使用（额外的 CPU-GPU 数据传输会降低训练速度）。

standard_en.summary: Uses Unsloth-style gradient offloading: during backward, non-essential intermediate activations move to the CPU, pushing peak VRAM down further.
standard_en.effect: Frees more VRAM, which can make a higher resolution or a larger batch fit, at the cost of slightly slower training.
standard_en.whenToUse: As a last resort when gradient_checkpointing and block_prefetch are both on and you still OOM.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not recommended when VRAM is plentiful -- the extra CPU-GPU traffic only slows the run down.

advanced.principle: Unsloth 方法在 backward 时主动将已完成 backward 的 block 权重卸载到 CPU，并在下一个 block 需要前预取回来，与计算重叠。等效于更细粒度的 gradient checkpointing + offload 组合。
advanced.tradeoffs: 实现复杂，与某些 LoRA 实现可能有兼容性问题；建议先用官方 gradient_checkpointing 方案，确认不够用后再尝试此选项。

advanced_en.principle: The Unsloth method proactively offloads blocks whose backward has completed to CPU during backward and prefetches them back before the next block needs them, overlapping with compute. Equivalent to a finer-grained gradient-checkpointing + offload combination.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Complex to implement and possibly incompatible with some LoRA implementations; try the official gradient_checkpointing first and only reach for this once it proves insufficient.
